AX rules that style static shell elements move into the inline <style>: skip links, screen-reader h1, splash caption, 44 px SEO links on touch screens; plus the gate that keeps the Extra Features overlay hidden until the deferred stylesheets are applied. Dead CSS on R1a, where AX is not built
